com.vector.cfg.model.sysdesc.api.port

Interface IComponentPort

  • All Superinterfaces:
    IHasModelObject, IModelAbstraction
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    ISourceComponentPort, ITargetComponentPort

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IComponentPort
extends IModelAbstraction
    A component port (IComponentPort) represents a port prototype and its corresponding component prototype, and in case of a delegation port the corresponding top level composition type (ECU Composition).

      • getComElementsFullExpanded

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<ICommunicationElement> getComElementsFullExpanded()
        Retrieves ICommunicationElements of this IComponentPort which are suitable for data mapping. The complex data elements are full expanded down to the leaf elements. This method can be used to get communication elements which can be (or are already) mapped to system signals.

        Examples:
        1. For a record 'Record1' with the record elements 'RE1', 'RE2', 'RE3' this method will return {'Record1', 'RE1', 'RE2', 'RE3'}, so that the record can be mapped to a system signal group and each record element to a group signal.
        2. For a primitive array of uint8 'Array1' with array size 2 this method will return {'Array1', 'Array1[0]', 'Array1[1]'}, so that the array can be mapped to a system signal group and the array elements to its group signals. If you want to map the array to one single system signal please use getComElementsFullExpandedExceptPrimitiveArrays().
        3. For an array 'Array2' with array size 2 and its array element being a record 'Record2' with record elements 'RE1' and 'RE2' the method will return {'Array2', 'Array2[0].RE1', 'Array2[0].RE2', 'Array2[1].RE1', 'Array2[1].RE2'}. The array can be now mapped to a system signal group and the record elements to the group signals.

        Returns:
        A collection of all full expanded communication elements suitable for data mapping for this IComponentPort.

      • getComElementsFullExpandedExceptPrimitiveArrays

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<ICommunicationElement> getComElementsFullExpandedExceptPrimitiveArrays()
        Retrieves ICommunicationElements of this IComponentPort which are suitable for data mapping. The complex data elements are full expanded down to the leaf elements, except arrays with primitive array elements. So this method should be used if you want to map the whole primitive array to a system signal instead of mapping each of the array elements separately.
        Does not filter for unmapped communication elements.
        See getComElementsFullExpanded() for examples.
        Returns:
        A collection of all full expanded communication elements suitable for data mapping without expanding primitive arrays.

      • getMdfObject

        @PublishedMethod
com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.base.MIIdentifiable getMdfObject()
        Returns the underlying IModelObject of this wrapper instance.

        The method will never return null.

        IModelAbstraction.getMdfObject() is a bridge from the IModelAbstraction to the underlying MDF object. For compound model abstractions, the main object will be returned, e.g. returns the port for a component port.

        The returned MIObject is as most specific as possible (e.g. MIIdentifiable) but AUTOSAR version independent. For more advanced features, it has to be cast to the actual used element (e.g. MIAssemblySwConnector) according to AUTOSAR. This can be determined by MDFBaseObject.mdfGetInterfaceClass().

        Specified by:
        getMdfObject in interface IHasModelObject
        Specified by:
        getMdfObject in interface IModelAbstraction
        Returns:
        Returns the underlying IModelObject of the port for this IComponentPort.

      • isCompleted

        @PublishedMethod
boolean isCompleted()

        A delegation port is completed if and only if the port is data mapped and connected.
        An inner port is completed if the port is data mapped or connected.
        Hint: For multiple communication elements on one port, data mapped means that all communication elements have to be mapped.

        Returns:
        true if the port is completed, false otherwise.
